At some point between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] carried out<ref name="GG10" /> a successful<ref name="TEA" /> '''attack''' on an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] base at [[Shadren V]], which led to the [[Chandrex Grenn's sister|sister]] of the [[Iotran/Legends|Iotran]] Imperial [[Chandrex Grenn]] going missing.<ref name="GG10" />
